change: In the wide FP16 path, add a 32-byte pad to valueFp32Buf_ so value and residual scratch begin at different allocation phases. Include the added bytes in the FP16 UB row-budget calculation. No arithmetic, tensor indexing, or synchronization changed.
hypothesis: The R004 layout leaves valueFp32Buf_ and residualFp32Buf_ at the same 32-byte allocation phase even though Mul reads value and writes residual. One transfer-aligned allocation offset may reduce same-phase bank contention; this is an unmeasured hypothesis, not a claimed bank width or performance result.
